data_a.situation: A shortfall warning on the Marchmont Enclosure order, job QM-2031-0570, is corrected twice before it is sent.
known_facts: Sixteen pieces are due to Marchmont Enclosure on QM-2031-0570.
The crin for the brim edges had not arrived when the coordinator first wrote the message.
Marchmont Enclosure's goods-in desk sets the acceptance window for each delivery.
The workroom manager speaks to Marchmont Enclosure each morning.
constraints: Delivery windows are set by the client's goods-in desk.
The coordinator reports a shortfall to the workroom manager as soon as it is known.

turns.input_raw:
Check this before I send it to Marit.

Draft under review:
Marit - heads up before tomorrow: we are going to be 6 pieces short on the Marchmont order for Thursday. I would rather you had it from me now than on Wednesday night.
Update the numbers: it is 4 short, not 6. Two of the six came good after a second steam cycle. The reason for the remaining four is the same, the crin for the brim edges has not landed.

Last change. Ferrowhite have confirmed the crin lands Wednesday 15 October at 12:00, and Marchmont's goods-in have moved their acceptance window to Thursday 16 October, 07:30 to 09:30. That means all 16 go in one delivery after all. Please redraft it as the full 16 pieces, one delivery, Thursday 16 October, 07:30 to 09:30, and drop the shortfall.
